description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys IPC callback handling in the Rialto client, including tests for license request forwarding, license renewal, and key status change events, with various invalid handle scenarios.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysIpcCallbackTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the IPC callback handling in the Rialto client media keys implementation, including setup for license request messages, key statuses, and event creation methods.

methods.name: addPairsToKeyStatusVector
methods.description: Adds a specified number of key status pairs to the internal key status vector for testing.

methods.name: createLicenseRequestEvent
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a LicenseRequestEvent with preset handle, URL, session ID, and license request message.

methods.name: createKeyStatusesChangedEvent
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a KeyStatusesChangedEvent with preset handle, session ID, and key status pairs.
